narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Explanation -> Clinical Evidence -> Comparison -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a professional medical educational piece designed to address and alleviate patient concerns regarding the side effects of oral Roaccutane. By combining an authoritative yet friendly vocal delivery with clear on-screen textual evidence and clinical anecdotes, the speaker builds trust. The intent is to contrast the feared side effects of Roaccutane with those of more common medications, ultimately promoting the safety and efficacy of the treatment as managed by the clinic.
